name: runs_write

ops.description: Write operations, one flat object per op, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

rootId.description: The root item the run belongs to. Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: open]

items.description: Member items, at most 500. Each is an item of the root that has a lifecycle and is in no other open run. [ops: open]

scopeId.description: An item the run is scoped to. Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: open]

label.description: A short label, at most 64 characters. [ops: open]

title.description: A title, at most 200 characters. [ops: open]

budget.description: Run budget: tokens, costUsd, attemptsPerSeat, maxActiveSeats; absent means no cap. On open it may not exceed a configured ceiling; on update a field can only be lowered or newly set. [ops: open]

costUsd.description: Cost limit in US dollars, a decimal such as 12.5.

attemptsPerSeat.description: Most attempts one seat may take.

stallAfterSeconds.description: Seconds without a coordinator sign of life before the run reads as stalled. Default from config. [ops: open]

hints.description: Short structured coordinator hints, string to string. On update they replace the stored hints. [ops: open]

runId.description: Run id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: close, pause, resume]

reason.description: Why the run ends: completed, cancelled, failed or abandoned. completed is refused while a seat is active. [ops: close]

decisionId.description: Decision id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: ack, answer, withdraw]

option.description: Key of the chosen option. [ops: answer]

text.description: Free-form answer, at most 1000 characters; freeform classes only. [ops: answer]

rationale.description: Why this answer, at most 1000 characters. [ops: answer]

amount.description: run-budget extend only: how much to add, in the breached dimension (whole tokens, or US dollars). [ops: answer]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Open, update, close, pause, resume and mark runs; assign and end seats; raise, ack, answer and withdraw decisions. Each op needs the runs capability (ack, answer: decide) and a root in scope. close: coordinator, director or a human; update, assign: coordinator token; end_seat: the seat's own token; pause and resume: director or human only; mark: REST only. Result: the run (close adds snapshot, mark adds marked) or the decision. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
